title: A client can now buy the closure of several companies in one offer
text: The offer builder now has a quantity box for Company Closure. When the offer is paid, one closure job is made for each company (numbered #1, #2 and so on) instead of only one, and the client portal shows one numbered closure form card for each company still owed.
points: On the CRM contact page, each active closure job shows as a banner and as a chip in the Flows strip. Staff only; clients do not see it.
A retried payment only makes the jobs that are missing, never a second copy of one that exists.
In the contract, an add-on that is included at $0 now says Included - no separate charge instead of a total fee of 0, payable in full.
